title: How I turned a $100k loss into a +$246k gain in just 30 days
author: PopHaunting7864
selftext:
A month ago, I lost $100,000 due to reckless, emotionally driven trading. I was forced to step back from the market, reset my mindset, and rebuild my trading system from scratch.  
  
I lost that $100,000 because I blindly chased rallies buying options at market highs while completely ignoring technicals and market structure.  
  
I disregarded stop-losses and harbored false hopes, watching a manageable $5,000 loss balloon into a massive $100,000 drawdown.  
  
I used excessive leverage and oversized positions, leaving absolutely no margin for error.  
  
I paused trading for 48 hours to face reality. I abandoned reliance on luck and revenge trading, shifting instead to a strategy strictly grounded in probability and risk control.  
  
I implemented strict risk limits, setting hard stop-losses and capping exposure on each trade to a fixed percentage  
  
I adopted a strategy of scaling out profits consistently locking in 30% 50% gains rather than stubbornly holding on in hopes of a 1,000% windfall
